\begin{document}
Energies are measured from the Fermi level,
\begin{equation}
\xi \equiv \epsilon - \mu .
\label{eq:xi}
\end{equation}
Within the Debye shell the second moment is
\begin{equation}
\int_{-\omega_D}^{\omega_D} d\xi\, \xi^2 = \frac{2\omega_D^3}{3} .
\label{eq:mom}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
